701:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But more than that, what this machine and we carry is hope and wishes for the world to come!」

701:t_114:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I've already shaken off the past, or rather...」

701:t_114:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! Then I will surpass even that! Even if I have no future, I will defeat them with my own hands!!」

701:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You seek nothing but power. I'll teach you what truly matters, the thing that creates that power!」

701:t_115:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And what is that?」

701:t_115:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The heart that loves someone! That is what creates infinite power!」

701:t_115:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I won't call that answer worthless.」

701:t_115:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I chose to throw that away and fight! And I obtained a power that surpasses everything!」

701:t_115:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now it's my turn to teach you! The power that surpasses even love, the power that kills gods!!」

701:t_115:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「There's no way the heart that loves, mine... ours, loses to something like that!!」

701:t_116:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Those who carry doubt, do not stand before me!」

701:t_116:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...That's not... something you get to decide...」

701:t_116:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm... going to fight...! Because right now... it's all I have!」

701:t_116:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you overcome your doubts in the midst of battle...」

701:t_116:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, boy! I acknowledge you as one worthy of fighting me!」

701:t_116:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't need that... But I... I...!」

701:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're pathetic! I've never seen anyone fighting such a pointless fight!」

701:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You keep talking about your mission or whatever, but once you've beaten the $$御使い$$s, your life is just an empty husk!」

701:t_117:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「In short, it's like you're fighting in order to kill yourself!」

701:t_117:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so...! Even so, I can't afford to stop walking!」

701:t_117:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you can't stop, then I'll stop you! And I'll teach you!」

701:t_117:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How wonderful it is to fight for someone!!」

701:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you too wish for $$シンカ$$, you should stop fighting and look for a way to live together!」

701:t_118:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is a dream long past... Now I seek only power!」

701:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「A power gained that way has no meaning! Then you're no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_118:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I go on! I will simply keep running down a road with no turning back!」

701:t_118:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't stand any more sacrifices being born from a pointless fight!!」

701:t_119:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Forerunner! Have you gained even greater power through $$真化融合$$!」

701:t_119:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With this power, I'll stop you, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

701:t_119:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You... seem to be a being close to me.」

701:t_119:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't deny it. A man like me could hardly be called a forerunner of humanity's evolution.」

701:t_119:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I've entrusted that mission to those who follow! I just want to see where humanity is headed!」

701:t_119:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why I fight! To eliminate beings like you and the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_119:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A clash between those who share the same mission! But the one who wins will be me!!」

701:t_120:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you have any feeling for mourning the souls that were lost, stop this fight!」

701:t_120:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That would make their deaths meaningless.」

701:t_120:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's why I fight...! To repay every life I took!」

701:t_120:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I won't let your souls go to waste either! All of it will become my flesh, blood and fighting spirit, and turn into the power to strike down the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_120:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't get drunk on what you've done! You knew you could create power without such sacrifices, so why didn't you do that!?」

701:t_120:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I reject your way of fighting! What the universe seeks... the truth... can't be something like that!!」

701:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Taking a life means killing a possibility! What you've done is crush futures that might have happened!」

701:t_121:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「To repay that, I will strike down the $$御使い$$s with this power!」

701:t_121:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even if you win, the lives that were lost won't come back!」

701:t_121:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What you should have done was gather the power to fight and widen those possibilities!」

701:t_121:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...It's all in the past...! If the past can't be changed, then I'll simply fight to atone for it!」

701:t_121:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I fight to protect possibility... the future! Even if it's a hard road, I won't accept a way that sacrifices someone's life for a goal!!」

701:t_122:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Taking someone's life to open up the future... You're the same as we used to be!」

701:t_122:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You're saying you've broken free of that?」

701:t_122:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Past sins don't disappear... But I've learned that people can change.」

701:t_122:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's why I fight! I dedicate this life... everything... to peace!」

701:t_122:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A will that has overcome doubt... Your heart is stronger than mine...」

701:t_122:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But defeat is not permitted to me! With the power gained by the way you cast off, I will surpass you!!」

701:t_123:0.en:
$$シン$$
「No matter how you try to gloss it over, the lives you took are never coming back!」

701:t_123:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But it became the power to defeat them.」

701:t_123:2.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll beat the $$御使い$$s without doing it that way!」

701:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「For that too, I'll defeat you here... you who are bound to battle!」

701:t_123:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, warrior! I acknowledge that you overcame sorrow and doubt and reached that state!」

701:t_123:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will surpass even that! That is the power to kill gods!!」

701:t_124:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A fine fighting spirit. Have you come to this place resolved?」

701:t_124:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「Searching for what I can do before sacrificing anyone... and staking my own life on it...!」

701:t_124:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「That is the resolve I've arrived at!」

701:t_124:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You too overcame your doubts and reached that point...」

701:t_124:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Though our answers differ, we are the same kind of being! Then there is no need for restraint!」

701:t_124:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll do it! With the feelings and power entrusted to me, I'll stop you!」

701:t_125:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The man who was called the $$赤い彗星$$... You are the same kind of being as me.」

701:t_125:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't deny it. Like you, I was a man who didn't hesitate to cause sacrifices for my goals.」

701:t_125:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now I am just a man! I'll take on the role of freeing you from the mission and responsibility that bind you!」

701:t_125:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Try it if you can! If you would stop me, show me a power that surpasses me!!」

701:t_126:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack objective: $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$.」

701:t_126:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's it! Cast off all doubt and challenge me!」

701:t_126:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Overcoming that gives me strength. That's how I've fought.」

701:t_126:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then show me that power! If you claim you're the same as me!」

701:t_126:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I... will not become like you!」
